description: Read one UI skill by its id, as returned by mba_list_ui_skills or mba_create_ui_skill. A UI skill is NOT an agent skill (mba_list_agent_skills): an agent skill is instruction text that shapes what the agent says, a UI skill lets the agent send one kind of rich WhatsApp component and tells it when to send that component.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_ui_skill
title: Read a UI skill
